question: Identify the amendment in Constitution of India, which is related to Panchayati Raj institutions from following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**73rd amendment**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **73rd amendment** to the Constitution of India is related to the establishment and empowerment of Panchayati Raj institutions.
 
• This amendment was enacted in **1992** and came into force on **24th April 1993**.
 
• It added a **new Part IX** to the Constitution titled "**The Panchayats**" and also added a **new Eleventh Schedule covering 29 subjects** within the functions of Panchayats.
 
• The amendment mandates the creation of Panchayats at the village, intermediate, and district levels.
 
• It aims to decentralize power and ensure local self-governance, providing a greater degree of participation by people at the grassroots level in decision-making processes.
 
• The act also includes provisions for the reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written** constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The 73rd Amendment has played a crucial role in strengthening the democratic fabric of rural India by empowering local governance structures.
